newsitem.title: USA: Cytec sells aluminum sulfate business.
newsitem.headline: Cytec sells aluminum sulfate business.

text.p: Cytec Industries Inc said it sold its aluminum sulfate business to GEO Specialty Chemicals Inc of Cleveland, Ohio.
The transaction includes seven alum manufacturing plants in the Southeast and a kaolin calcining plant with associated reserves in Andersonville, Ga. Sales are primarily to the paper industry.
Everen Securities Inc advised Cytec on the transaction, it said.

As previously announced Cytec had been exploring options to enhance the value of its commodity aluminum sulfate ("alum") business along with its kaolin mining and calcining facility located in Andersonville.
